players.name: Stephen
players.note: Efficient late in rounds with smart positioning and consistent finishing throws.
players.style: Efficient closer with sharp positioning and low-error finishes.

players.name: Rickey Serret
players.note: Heavy thrower with quick feet and strong late-game finishing pressure.
players.style: Aggressive attacker who forces reactions and capitalizes on broken formations.

players.name: Evan
players.note: Mid-level thrower with a 54 mph max, but an excellent catcher who changes rallies with secure hands.
players.style: Balanced two-way player who leans on timing, catches, and steady pressure more than raw throw speed.

players.name: Rae
players.note: Still learning timing and positioning, with inconsistent reads under pressure.
players.style: Developing support player who needs cleaner decisions and better recovery movement.

players.name: Allyn Thomas
players.note: Veteran leader who has been playing since age 13, throws decently, catches well, and keeps teammates organized.
players.style: Short, mobile team-first captain who steadies the floor with reliable hands and smart leadership.
